identity.title: Is The Bible True? White vs Price 5/6/2010
identity.dateBasis: The public YouTube title and Alpha and Omega Ministries' event listing identify White and Price's 2010 Bible-truth debate. The title says May 6; the ministry's event list says May 7. Preserve the supported year without resolving the day discrepancy by assumption. Speaker introductions and the announced format identify the opponents and moderator.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: The full public caption track reaches the recording end. All full-recording bytes are preserved; judgment access is restricted to the separately locked approved formal-rounds packet.

participants.basis: Only the two named opponents advance the motion within the approved formal rounds. Moderator transitions are procedural. All later audience material and the moderator’s separate concluding apologetic argument are outside the assessment; the two opponents’ formal closing statements remain included.

formalRoundsScope.scope: Only the formal rounds, including opening statements, rebuttals, cross-examinations, and both closing statements, are assessed. Introductions, later audience questions and answers, and the moderator's separate concluding Christian apologetic argument are excluded. Moderator logistics within the approved window are not scored.
